newsitem.title: ITALY: German rates low thanks to mark - Italy's Fazio.
newsitem.headline: German rates low thanks to mark - Italy's Fazio.

text.p: German official interest rates are much lower than Italian rates thanks to the stability of the German mark and a general appreciation of the currency, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Wednesday.
"German interest rates reflect the great stability over time, of the currency and a tendential appreciation of the exchange rate," Fazio said in a speech at the Italian Banking Association.

The Bank of Italy has held its official discount rate pegged at 6.75 percent since January despite steadily falling inflation and repeated calls from the government, unions and business leaders for a rate cut. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
